name: field
title: Field
description: Form field: a label (with optional required marker), the hint or error, then its control, wired together with `aria-describedby`. Copy: the label names the value, not the input — "Work email", not "Enter your email". The hint is a rule that applies before typing; the error is what happened and what to do — "Add a country code", never "Invalid".
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/Field.json
